answer: Make every new agent post a refundable deposit before it can trade. A real harbor of honest agents builds up deposits over time, while a sybil attacker must pay the same deposit for each fake identity and loses it when the fake misbehaves. A reputation oasis grows around agents with a long deposit history, and cheap quartz copies with no stake stay outside the trusted market. The cost scales with each fake, so mass identities stop paying off.
